sentences.text: Champion is a 1949 American film noir drama sport film based on a short story by Ring Lardner .	Ring Lardner	Ring Lardner	film noir	film noir
It recounts the struggles of boxer `` Midge '' Kelly fighting his own demons while working to achieve success in the boxing ring .	boxer	boxing	boxing ring	boxing ring
The drama was directed by Mark Robson , with cinematography by Franz Planer .	Mark Robson	Mark Robson	Franz Planer	Franz Planer	cinematography	cinematography
The drama features Kirk Douglas , Marilyn Maxwell , and Arthur Kennedy .	Kirk Douglas	Kirk Douglas	Marilyn Maxwell	Marilyn Maxwell	Arthur Kennedy	Arthur Kennedy

The film won an Academy Award for Editing and gained five other nominations as well , including a Best Actor for Douglas .	Academy Award for Editing	Academy Award for Editing	Best Actor	Academy Award for Best Actor
Several clips from the film were used in Douglas ' 1999 film Diamonds to illustrate his character 's career as a boxer .	boxer	boxing	Diamonds	Diamonds (1999 film)
